description: Cookie consent banner with granular category controls and persistence

attributes.name: persist
attributes.description: VBStore key under namespace 'consent'. Stored in localStorage as vb:consent:<persist>.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Banner position. Center uses modal dialog.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: CSS selector for a re-open button (e.g. #manage-cookies)

attributes.name: expires
attributes.description: Days until stored consent expires (banner and getConsent). 0 or 'never' disables expiry.

structure.description: Banner container — shown until consent is given. Named from its first heading (aria-labelledby) or aria-label="Cookie consent" unless the author names it.
Granular preference toggles (optional, for save mode)
Save granular preferences button (optional, used with checkboxes)

childAttributes.name: value
childAttributes.description: Action button type — accept all, reject all, or save granular preferences

childAttributes.name: name
childAttributes.description: Preference category name; becomes a key in the stored and emitted preferences object

events.name: consent-banner:change
events.description: Fired when the user clicks an accept, reject, or save button. preferences maps checkbox names to booleans; action is the button's value.

methods.name: ConsentBanner.getConsent(key?, options?)
methods.description: Static. Read stored consent for key (default 'banner'). Honours expiry: options.expires (days), else the expires attribute of an in-document banner with the same persist key, else 365. Resolves null when missing, expired, or storage is unavailable.

methods.name: ConsentBanner.reset(key?)
methods.description: Static. Clear stored consent for key (default 'banner') so the banner reappears on the next load.
